finetuned.title: Chocolate Chip Cookies
directions: In bowl, beat together sugar, butter, flour, salt and vanilla.
Add eggs.
Fold in chocolate chips.
Put in greased 9 x 13-inch pan.
Bake at 350° for 35 to 45 minutes.
Cool slightly.
Do not stir.
finetuned.raw:
<|recipe|>
<|ingredients|> flour; butter; sugar; eggs; chocolate chips
<|title|> Chocolate Chip Cookies
<|ingredient_list|>
- 2 c. sugar
- 1/4 c. butter
- 1 c. flour
- 2 tsp. salt
- 1/4 tsp. vanilla
- 2 eggs
- 1/2 c. chocolate chips
<|directions|>
1. In bowl, beat together sugar, butter, flour, salt and vanilla.
2. Add eggs.
3. Fold in chocolate chips.
4. Put in greased 9 x 13-inch pan.
5. Bake at 350° for 35 to 45 minutes.
6. Cool slightly.
7. Do not stir.
<|end|>
